game_status_consistent.name: game_status_consistent
game_status_consistent.value:
(
    ("game"."status_code" = 'in_progress' AND "game"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "game"."interruption_reason" IS NULL) OR
    ("game"."status_code" = 'completed' AND "game"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "game"."interruption_reason" IS NULL) OR
    ("game"."status_code" = 'interrupted' AND "game"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "game"."interruption_reason" IS NOT NULL)
  ) AND ("game"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "game"."ended_at" >= "game"."started_at")

participant_identity.name: participant_identity
participant_identity.value: ("game_participant"."identity_state" = 'registered' AND "game_participant"."display_name" IS NOT NULL) OR ("game_participant"."identity_state" = 'deleted_user' AND "game_participant"."display_name" IS NULL)

participant_status.name: participant_status
participant_status.value: ("game_participant"."participation_status" = 'participating' AND "game_participant"."left_at" IS NULL) OR ("game_participant"."participation_status" = 'left' AND "game_participant"."left_at" IS NOT NULL)

result_counts.name: result_counts
result_counts.value: "game_question_result"."option_count" IN (2,4,6) AND "game_question_result"."correct_option_count" BETWEEN 1 AND "game_question_result"."option_count" AND "game_question_result"."selected_correct_count" BETWEEN 0 AND "game_question_result"."correct_option_count" AND "game_question_result"."selected_incorrect_count" BETWEEN 0 AND ("game_question_result"."option_count" - "game_question_result"."correct_option_count") AND "game_question_result"."points_awarded" >= 0

lol_skin_parent.name: lol_skin_parent
lol_skin_parent.value: ("lol_skin"."is_chroma" = ("lol_skin"."parent_skin_id" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("lol_skin"."parent_skin_id" IS NULL OR "lol_skin"."parent_skin_id" <> "lol_skin"."id")

dataset_ready.name: dataset_ready
dataset_ready.value: "question_dataset"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("question_dataset"."content_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "question_dataset"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "question_dataset"."counts" IS NOT NULL AND "question_dataset"."imported_champions" = "question_dataset"."expected_champions")
